human_actions_pending.action: Phase 1d requires user registration endpoint for full auth-dependent test coverage
human_actions_pending.context: REST search, CLI page CRUD, and CLI stats all blocked during UAT because there's no /auth/register endpoint. Users can only be created via database seeding.

decisions.decision: MCP stdio auth uses SMARTCOPILOT_MCP_TOKEN env var
REST endpoints use Bearer JWT auth via Authorization header
WebSocket uses first-frame auth pattern with JWT token
CLI commands require --user <user_id> for per-user operations
Capabilities endpoint is public (no auth required)

context_notes: Phase 1d completed all 6 plans. UAT verified 7/12 tests passed, 4 blocked (auth required), 1 skipped. No code issues found. UAT committed as test(01d): complete UAT. Next logical step is /gsd-secure-phase 1d or /gsd-plan-phase 2a.
